rows.note: Use 百分之N as the all-purpose way to state a numerical percentage, including one percent.

example.english: Eighty percent of the voters supported this plan.
example.traditional: 今次投票有百分之八十嘅人支持呢個方案。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 tau4 piu3 jau5 baak3 fan6 zi1 baat3 sap6 ge3 jan4 zi1 ci4 ni1 go3 fong1 on3

rows.note: Use 巴仙 in casual speech, especially after a number, as a colloquial alternative to 百分之N.

example.english: This promotion gives a twenty percent discount.
example.traditional: 今次優惠有八折，即係平咗二十巴仙。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 jau1 wai6 jau5 baat3 zit3 zik1 hai6 peng4 zo2 ji6 sap6 baa1 sin1

rows.note: Use 百分比 when referring to a percentage as a ratio or measured figure rather than stating the number itself.

example.english: This chart clearly shows what percent each age group makes up.
example.traditional: 呢張圖清楚咁顯示各年齡層佔嘅百分比。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 tou4 cing1 co2 gam3 hin2 si6 gok3 nin4 ling4 cang4 zim3 ge3 baak3 fan6 bei2
